paper_style.palette_strategy: 主线使用蓝色 AO/Arbitrary Order 与橙色 AR Order/JustGRPO；Figure 5/11 用绿/红扩展系列，概念图使用低饱和红蓝米色。marker、位置和文字提供部分冗余。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Figure 1/2/4/6 含嵌入栅格或混合局部资源；Figure 3/5/7–9 与附录图表主要为 PDF 矢量。作者仓库仅有两个 README PNG，没有生成脚本。
paper_style.style_consistency: caption 标题普遍粗体，表格统一 booktabs 横线无竖线，正文/表格使用 Computer Modern/Times 风格；图内小 multiples 与 raster/Calibri 资源造成字号和字形的局部不一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Less flexibility unlocks better reasoning potential. Left: We observe a counter-intuitive phenomenon where restricting dLLMs to standard Autoregressive (AR) order expands the reasoning solution space. Right: Motivated by this, we propose “JustGRPO”. By foregoing arbitrary-order adaptations and adopting just GRPO, we elicit the reasoning capability of dLLMs more effectively. Results reported on LLaDA-Instruct (Nie et al., 2025) with generation length of 256. Baseline results are quoted from their papers². We also include reproduced results under a matched configuration in Table 2.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色阶表示 d1/ESPO/SPG/GDPO 或 Arbitrary Order，橙色表示 JustGRPO/AR Order；柱位、marker 和数值标签提供辅助语义。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Confronting vs. bypassing uncertainty. (a) AR order preserves reasoning space by forcing decisions at uncertain tokens. (b) Arbitrary order bypasses uncertainty and resolves easier tokens first. Once future context is established, the original branching possibilities are effectively pruned.

color.semantic_mapping: 红圆表示 Uncertain/Forking Tokens，蓝圆表示 Other Tokens，浅色节点表示未来上下文，红叉表示被 bypass 的 fork。

encodings.text: 行标题、Too hard/bypass 与 Now it is easier 标签

figures.data_and_statistics: 概念机制图，不展示样本、聚合、单位、重复或不确定性；通过 token 角色和未来上下文的箭头说明 AR confronts uncertainty 与 AO bypasses uncertainty。
figures.evidence_relation: logical fork 与 entropy spike 的正文描述 → AR/AO 路径示意 → Figure 6–7 connector/entropy evidence → Figure 12 扩展 token 检查；示意本身不是因果干预结果。
design_strengths: 正常路径、跳过路径和未来上下文在同一对齐图中可追踪。
颜色、行标题、符号和文字共同说明机制入口。

没有时间步或概率量化，不能单独验证 entropy degradation 幅度。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用对齐的正常/替代路径把 uncertainty handling 变成状态转移，再将量化检验放到后续图表。

caption.text: Figure 3: Reasoning potential measured by Pass@k. While arbitrary order is competitive in single-shot settings (k = 1), it exhibits flatter scaling curves compared to AR Order. This observation is consistent across different dLLMs and general reasoning benchmarks.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: More arbitrariness, less potential. We sweep the semi-autoregressive decoding block size B for different levels of order arbitrariness: B = 1 recovers pure AR order and larger B grants the sampler more freedom in choosing which positions to resolve next. Results are measured on HumanEval with LLaDA-Instruct.

color.semantic_mapping: 绿色方块、蓝色三角、红色菱形分别表示 Pass@8、Pass@32、Pass@128；x 轴表示 B 及其 order arbitrariness。

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Training efficiency on GSM8K. Despite its larger per-iteration overhead, JustGRPO achieves a better accuracy/wall-time trade-off than the approximation-based baseline (ESPO), which saturates early. JustGRPO-Fast, which computes the probability ratio ρi,k only at the top-25% highest-entropy positions, accelerates training further. Wall time is measured on 16×H100 GPUs.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝、橙、深红分别表示 ESPO、JustGRPO、JustGRPO-Fast；圆/方/三角 marker 提供冗余。

figures.data_and_statistics: GSM8K accuracy–wall-time，16×H100；JustGRPO 在相近时间达到/超过 ESPO，JustGRPO-Fast 进一步改善 trade-off。Fast 只在 top-25% highest-entropy positions 计算 ρi,k，减少 75% ratio evaluations。无 raw time 表、重复或离散度。
figures.evidence_relation: Eq. (8) exact per-position ratio → Section 3 high-entropy fork → Figure 9 exact/Fast cost curve；与 Table 2 质量结果一起限定可接受成本，而非普遍效率保证。
design_strengths: quality 与 wall-clock 位于同一决策面，Fast 变体有独立 marker。
caption 暴露高 entropy 筛选、计算削减和硬件条件。
design_weaknesses: 单一 GSM8K 与 16×H100 环境限制外推，且没有 error band 或具体时间表。
曲线点少，近邻方法差异的重复稳定性不可见。
figures.reusable_pattern: 对训练方法同时展示质量和 wall-clock，并把降低成本的变体纳入同一坐标系。

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: System-level comparison of post-training approaches on LLaDA-Instruct. JustGRPO achieves strong performance despite its simplicity. Baseline numbers are mostly quoted from their original papers². We note that the experimental settings are not fully consistent across these baselines. JustGRPO uses full fine-tuning and unmasks one token per step for all tasks. Among the baselines, LLaDA-1.5, LLaDOU, and ESPO also unmask one token per step, whereas the others unmask two tokens per step; LLaDA-1.5 and LLaDOU likewise use full fine-tuning, ESPO does so only on code tasks (and LoRA otherwise), and the others use LoRA. Given this heterogeneity, we additionally reproduce several representative baselines whose original settings differ from ours, under a unified protocol in Table 2, where the same conclusion holds.

tables.uncertainty: 没有 mean±spread、error bar、区间、seed 数或显著性；缺失结果以 - 表示。
tables.data_and_statistics: accuracy (%)；9 个 post-training 方法 × GSM8K/MATH-500/HumanEval/MBPP × generation lengths 128/256/512。JustGRPO 为 GSM8K 83.8/89.1/89.8、MATH-500 39.0/45.1/45.2、HumanEval 37.8/49.4/48.7、MBPP 50.6/52.4/49.0。baseline 多为引用结果，full fine-tuning/LoRA 与每步 unmask 数异质。
tables.evidence_relation: Figure 1 bars → Table 1 system comparison → Table 2 matched protocol → Figure 8/9 parallel capability and cost；caption 显式把异质性和统一复现纳入链条。
design_strengths: 多任务、多长度和方法条件集中在一张宽表。
长 caption 暴露 quoted baseline 与设置差异，缺失值可见。
design_weaknesses: 13 列密度高，需依赖 caption 理解可比性。
粗体只表示点值优，不代表统计优越，且没有不确定性。
tables.reusable_pattern: 主表保留广泛系统覆盖，同时在 caption 说明 quoted/复现边界，并用独立 matched table 处理异质条件。

evidence.label: Table 1；两层 benchmark/length 表头、9 行数值与 caption

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Reproduction with configurations aligned to ours (full fine-tuning, one token per decoding step, generation length 256). Reproduced baselines are marked with ∗. ESPO∗ results on HumanEval and MBPP are taken directly from the original paper, whose setting already matches ours (full fine-tuning, one token per decoding step).

tables.uncertainty: 没有 seed、误差、区间或重复统计；– 表示该 reproduced baseline 在该 benchmark 无结果。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 现象与方法名 → Figure 2 uncertainty 机制 → Figure 3–5 scaling/coverage/B → Figure 6–7 entropy mechanism → Table 1–2 与 Figure 8–9 结果、并行能力和成本；附录 Figure 10–12、Table 3–6 补 sensitivity、失败控制与通用能力边界。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 多数主文 caption 使用粗体结论标题＋设置＋比较对象＋主发现；Figure 10/12 只有标题，Figure 11 缺模型/数据集，附录 caption 需要正文补完。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 结果表使用 benchmark→length 两层表头或 Model→benchmark 单层表头，附录超参/控制表使用 Parameter/Value 或 Model/benchmark；booktabs 与粗体点值贯穿六表。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Eq. (5)–(8) 的 AR factorization/standard GRPO → Figure 3–7 reasoning-boundary/mechanism → Table 1–2 matched quality → Figure 8 parallel inference → Figure 9 exact/Fast cost；B、temperature、sampler、random order 是 sensitivity/failure controls。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: Figure 3 由 Figure 10 温度、Figure 11 sampler、Figure 12 connector 扩展；Figure 4 与 Table 4/5 random controls 相连；Table 3 支持主结果复现，Table 6 限定 general-capability preservation。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 外置文字保持 Computer Modern/Times 风格，caption 约 10.9 pt、表体约 9 pt；Figure 1–2、6 与小 multiples 的 raster/Calibri 资源使估计置信度低于表格。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝=AO/Arbitrary Order、橙=AR/JustGRPO 是核心契约，Figure 5/11 增加绿/红；柱、marker、legend 通常冗余，但 Figure 4/6 的低饱和色和词云对灰度不友好。

most_reusable_patterns: 用页宽“趋势＋跨任务 bars”建立反直觉 headline，再用 matched table 处理异质 baseline。
将机制链拆成概念路径图 → token identity 词云 → 局部柱图＋global reference → 扩展 token panels。
对 order arbitrariness、temperature、sampler、random permutation 做单轴 sensitivity/failure control，并保持蓝橙语义。
把训练质量、并行推理兼容性和 wall-clock 成本放入独立但相连的图表，明确训练/推理边界。
failure_patterns: Table 1 的 quoted baseline 设置异质，忽略 caption 会造成不可比横向结论。
Figure 6、Figure 10、Figure 12 的频数/设置/颜色定义不足，不能单独支撑总体或因果主张。
性能图表无 seed、离散度或显著性表达；Figure 9 还受单一 GSM8K 与 16×H100 限制。
蓝橙及低饱和概念色在小图和灰度下退化，Figure 3/10 的重复 legend 压缩可读性。
Figure 4 overlap、Figure 6 word frequency 与 Figure 11 correlation 不能替代干预式机制验证。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 用统一的蓝/橙 AO–AR 对照从反直觉 headline 出发，依次将 uncertainty 机制、scaling/coverage、训练后质量、并行推理和成本压缩成主文证据链，再用附录 sensitivity 与失败控制限定结论边界。
